items.text: DO YOU WANT TO TAKE A BOAT BACK TO PHLAN?
THE BOAT DISEMBARKS YOU AT SOKAL KEEP.
items.direction: measured fantasy narration with quiet foreboding

items.text: THE SKELETON OF A LONG-DEAD ELF LIES HIDDEN BY ROCKS AND REEDS. ITS WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT ARE BADLY RUSTED AND CORRODED BY SALT, ITS LEATHERS ARE WORM EATEN AND CRUSTED IN DIRT.
IN A POUCH ON THE REMAINS IS A CRUMBLING PARCHMENT SCROLL WITH THE WORDS ...
items.direction: measured fantasy narration; discovery leading into an unfinished quotation

items.text: YOU HACK THE BODY TO BITS.
YOU SEE THE PITIFUL REMAINS OF A DEAD ELF. EVERYTHING OF VALUE HAS BEEN TAKEN OR DESTROYED.
items.direction: somber fantasy narration with restrained pity

items.text: A PACK OF UNDEAD SUDDENLY APPEARS.

items.direction: ominous fantasy narration with escalating tension

items.text: GHOSTLY SHAPES SCREECH OUT A DREADFUL KEENING HOWL
items.direction: dramatic fantasy narration; perform the dreadful ghostly outcry with supernatural intensity

items.text: A PALE FORM RISES BEFORE YOU.
